description: any_to_str_bytes (line 494) handles Utf8String, PrintableString, Ia5String, and VisibleString but not TeletexString (T61String) or BMPString. Legacy certificates (pre-2000 root CAs still in Mozilla NSS) frequently use TeletexString or BMPString for subject fields. When a chain includes such a cert, any_to_str_bytes returns None, the fallback is raw DER byte comparison (line 487), and the comparison will fail unless both certs happen to use the same encoding. This silently breaks name linkage for real-world legacy chains. TeletexString and BMPString should be decoded and case-folded appropriately, or at minimum the fallback should attempt byte-level comparison of the string content only (not the tag+length+value triple).
title: names_match does not handle TeletexString or BMPString for legacy certs
